facts.text: Caroline mentioned that seeing her mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best part of the experience.

evidence.quote: Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best!

facts.text: Caroline is planning an LGBTQ art show with her paintings, which is scheduled for next month.

evidence.quote: Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!

facts.text: Caroline described the pride event as being surrounded by love and acceptance, with an image of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air.

evidence.quote: The pride event was awesome! It was so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance.
